info.title: hotel8-pms
info.description: Sentin8 Hotel8:PMS — Property Management System for the hospitality industry.

get.summary:
`GET /v1/admin/{resource}` — admin data for the RFW tables. Each resource
maps to its Shield `read` action; unknown resources 404.

post.summary:
`POST /v1/admin/{resource}` — form-submit aliases. The RFW renderer only
POSTs; each alias calls the SAME public domain handler (shared business
rules), so the admin surface can create/update/delete exactly what staff
can.

get.summary:
`GET /v1/properties/{property_id}/companies/by-traveler/{profile_id}` — the
companies a traveler is bound to (multi-company session switcher).

`GET .../companies/{profile_id}/admin-provisioning` — whether the company
still needs its first corporate admin provisioned (no IdP + no bound
ADMIN user). The corporate login page reads this after company-code
verification to decide between the normal login and the provisioning flow.

put.summary:
`PUT .../companies/{profile_id}/admin-provisioning` — provision the first
corporate admin: binds the traveler (created on the fly when needed) as
`ADMIN` and stamps `preferences.provisioned_admin_at`. Idempotent —
re-provisioning an already-admin company is a no-op returning the
existing state with `already_provisioned: true`.

get.summary:
`GET /v1/properties/{property_id}/companies/{profile_id}/payment-methods` —
credit-approved methods for a company profile. Checkout surfaces the
`POSTPAY`/`BILL_TO_COMPANY` rows; everything else is bookkeeping.

post.summary:
`POST .../companies/{profile_id}/payment-methods` — hotel sales registers a
method or approves a pending one (admin surface).
`POST .../companies/{profile_id}/users` — bind a traveler to the company.

`POST /v1/properties/{property_id}/corporate-availability` — availability
for a corporate session (company_profile_id). Rate-mix policy: when the
request carries a company context, ONLY the negotiated rate plans linked
to that company (via `preferences.negotiated_rate_plan_ids`) are returned;
public plans are withheld so negotiated rates never leak to non-members
and members never book public rates against their contract. Companies
with no linked plans get an explicit empty result, not a public fallback.

get.summary: List digital keys for a reservation.

post.summary: Issue digital keys for a checked-in reservation (idempotent by room + count).

get.summary: Read stay feedback for a reservation.

post.summary: Submit (or update) stay feedback — one row per reservation.

get.summary:
Open folio for the in-house stay in a room — the kiosk/eGuest check-out
view over the same folio rows the per-reservation route returns.

`GET .../kiosk-config` — the terminal's mode menu source of truth (eKiosk
bootstrap read). Defaults are materialized on first read so the terminal
always gets a row.

`GET /v1/properties/{p}/payment-methods` — the signed-in guest's saved
payment methods, resolved by the session subject (holder-scoped). Rows
carry bill8 token references only — never PAN or token secrets (DESIGN.md
§3 secret-reference rule).

post.summary:
`POST /v1/properties/{p}/payment-methods` — save a tokenized method
(bill8 already holds the instrument; PMS stores the reference).

delete.summary:
`DELETE /v1/properties/{p}/payment-methods/{method_id}` — remove a saved
method (holder-scoped: only the owner's rows are deletable).

put.summary:
`PUT /v1/properties/{property_id}/profiles/{profile_id}/loyalty-number`
Sets the loyalty member number on a guest profile. Called by Hotel8:Loyalty
via `pms-client` over its HTTP API (DESIGN.md §1 — no cross-service SQL).

put.description:
Edits dates, occupancy, room type, rate plan, and special requests.
Terminal-status reservations (`CANCELLED`, `CHECKED_OUT`, `NO_SHOW`) refuse
edits with 409 — the state machine forbids mutating history.

get.summary:
Boarding pass — the check-in artifact the kiosk completion step renders
(room, dates, guest, key count). Computed from live rows, never stored.

post.summary:
`POST /v1/properties/{p}/reservations/{res_id}/link-guest` — bind the
signed-in session's guest profile to a booking made anonymously in eBooking.
post.description:
The binding surface is the profile chain: the anonymous booking carries the
booker profile row; signing in resolves the (possibly different) profile
the session subject owns. Linking merges the booker profile INTO the
session's profile via the same merge path ePMS staff use, so folio/keys/
requests all follow the stay.

Creates a `CONFIRMED` reservation from an available room type + guest name
(`source_code = 'WALKIN'`, `channel_code = 'KIOSK'`). The kiosk then
check-ins via the normal route. Refuses when the room type has no
availability for the requested window.
